notes: Variant unit WLC.2KI.17.13.v001 resolved to r00-base in the projection; no textual decision was made here (rule 9).
Both supplied *and*s stand between phrases the Hebrew merely juxtaposes — כָּל נְבִיאֵי כָל חֹזֶה and מִצְוֺתַי חֻקּוֹתַי — so no conjunction morpheme licenses either (rule 14's closing sentences).
